payload.core_mechanism_summary: Precomputes per-note positions closest to grid corners, then computes max Manhattan distance between notes using corner-opposite vertex pairs. Takes max over consecutive song notes.
payload.rationale: Algorithm does not perform systematic search or enumeration; it uses a geometric reduction to compute max distance in O(1) per note pair. This is not a complete search subtype; closest match is search_backtracking by rule, but the algorithm is direct computation.
